newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr yields end sharply up on Kia troubles.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr yields end sharply up on Kia troubles.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed sharply higher on Wednesday amid concerns about the financial crisis at the Kia Group, dealers said.
The central bank's supply of 500 billion won to the banking system did little to improve sentiment, they said.
The Seoul bond market will be closed on Thursday for Constitution Day holiday.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.05 pct vs Tuesday's 11.95
* 3-mth CDs close at 12.10 pct vs Tuesday's 11.90
* Average overnight call at 11.62 pct vs Tuesday's 11.50
Dealers said the central bank's emergency fund supply did little to improve the sentiment.
The Bank of Korea supplied 500 billion won to the banking system through repurchase agreements in addition to its supply of one trillion won on Tuesday.
